reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A long-term senior secured loan of up to €15 million in favour of Terme Catez d.d. to finance a capex program aimed at upgrading the hospitality facilities, including hotel refurbishments, water treatment infrastructure, energy efficiency upgrades, and new year-round attractions. Through this investment, the EBRD is supporting: (i) family-friendly, accessible tourism, given the Borrower's hotel facilities in the 3- to 4-star range; (ii) the promotion of domestic and regional travel, as 60% of visitors originate from Slovenia and neighbouring Croatia; and (iii) a shift toward lower-carbon tourism models by reducing reliance on long-haul travel and strengthening local, year-round destinationsI. In particular, the Project supports the green transition of Slovenia's tourism infrastructure through targeted energy-efficiency upgrades across the Borrower's portfolio of operational hotel assets, aiming to reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions. A key climate-resilience feature includes the installation of an on-site groundwater pumping facility, along with the introduction of a wastewater treatment system. Additionally, the Project will invest in human capital by implementing dedicated skills-development and training programmes for the Borrower's staff, strengthening capacity building and long-term competitiveness.
